title: Descending the Fractured Staircase
description: A woman in a flowing purple-grey gown with red accents descends a grand, cracked spiral staircase. The stairs and balustrade are disintegrating into floating fragments and film equipment including cameras, spotlights, and reels that tumble through the air.
prompt: A woman in an elegant off-shoulder purple-grey gown with red fabric details descends a grand curving marble staircase that is dramatically cracking and breaking apart. Film cameras, spotlights, film reels and debris float and fall through the air around her. The staircase leads down into a dark theater space with a glowing movie screen below. Cinematic lighting with dramatic beams cutting through the darkness, classical columns and framed paintings visible in the background, highly detailed surreal scene.
